tickets.subject: Invoice shows the wrong VAT rate

messages.text: Our latest invoice applies 21% VAT but we are exempt. Can you correct it?
Thanks Ingrid. I can see the exemption on file; I will reissue the invoice today.
Received the corrected invoice, thank you.
Great, marking this as resolved.

resolution.summary: Exemption certificate re-applied; corrected invoice issued.

tickets.subject: Cannot log in after password reset

messages.text: I reset my password but the login page says the account is locked.
I have unlocked the account. Please try again now.
Works now!

resolution.summary: Account lock cleared after repeated reset attempts.

messages.text: The CSV export from the patient dashboard drops the 'Clinic' column.
Reproduced. Escalating to engineering.
Looks like a regression in the export mapper from release 4.2.

tickets.subject: How do I add a new supplier user?

messages.text: We need to add three colleagues to the supplier portal. Where do I do that?
Go to Settings > Users > Invite. Could you confirm the three email addresses so I can check the domain is allowed?

tickets.subject: Slow page loads during store opening hours

messages.text: Reports are taking over a minute to load at 8am every day.
Thanks Marcus, we are looking at the query load for your tenant now.
Spike matches nightly batch overlap. Moving the batch to 02:00.

tickets.subject: Request: export maintenance logs to PDF

messages.text: It would help if we could export maintenance logs as PDF for audits.
We were charged twice for the March subscription.
I can confirm the duplicate. Refund request raised with finance.
Refund reference REF-8821 submitted to Finance.

tickets.subject: SSO login redirects to blank page

messages.text: After SSO the browser lands on a blank page.
Can you share the browser and version?
Could you run a training session for six new analysts?
Booked for 12 March, 10:00. Invite sent.

tickets.subject: Mobile app crashes on vessel list

messages.text: The app crashes every time I open the vessel list on Android.
We can reproduce it on Android 14. Fix in progress.
Please change our billing contact to finance@ironbridge.example.
Done.
What is the rate limit for the tracking API?
120 requests per minute per key; we can raise it on request.

resolution.summary: Rate limits explained; limit raised to 300/min.

tickets.subject: Report totals differ from our spreadsheet

messages.text: The weekly total is different from what we compute by hand.
Could you send the spreadsheet so we can compare the filters?

tickets.subject: Add a second approver to purchase flows

messages.text: We need two approvers for orders above $10,000.
Logged as a feature request. I will update you after planning.
Long company names overflow on the invoice PDF.
The only admin is locked out and we cannot add users.
Verified identity by phone and restored access.
Where is the CSV import template?
Sent the link to the template page.
New matters do not appear in search until the next day.
Audit results are not syncing from the plant tablets.
We are checking the sync queue for your tablets.
We would like to switch to annual billing.
Happy to. Please confirm the effective date.
The monthly energy report times out.
Looking into the report size.
Could shipments support custom tags?
The quote shows USD but we agreed EUR.
Corrected and resent.

resolution.summary: Currency corrected to EUR on the quotation.
